$comment: Source of truth for design tokens. See design-system.md for why each value is what it is. Consumed by the mobile app and the three web front-ends; changing a value here changes all four.

font.$comment: Noto per script. Subset and lazy-load per locale: shipping all seven families is several megabytes on a connection billed by the megabyte.

motion.$comment: All motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, and nothing may depend on an animation completing.

score.$comment: INVARIANT 6, as a visual rule. The score is never drawn as a red-to-green gauge, dial or speedometer: that is the visual language of an Indian credit bureau score, and the resemblance is the legal risk check_vocabulary.py exists to hold back. A picture makes it stronger than any word could. Use a position marker on a neutral track, in a single hue.
